title: Inference Gateway Performance
description: Real-time performance monitoring for the LLM inference gateway. Tracks concurrency, queue depth, latency distributions, token throughput, and error rates.

panels.title: Active Inference Requests
panels.description: Currently in-flight inference requests (streaming + non-streaming). Compare against INFERENCE_MAX_CONCURRENCY.

panels.title: Queue Depth
panels.description: Requests waiting for a concurrency slot. Non-zero means all slots are occupied.

panels.title: Overload Rejections
panels.description: Rate of 503 overload rejections (queue full). Should be zero in steady state.

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: Chat completion request rate by mode.

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Chat completion error rate by kind. Spikes indicate upstream or infrastructure issues.

panels.title: Upstream Timeouts
panels.description: Rate of upstream (llama.cpp) timeout errors.

panels.title: Active Requests & Queue Depth
panels.description: Active inference requests overlaid with queue depth. When queue depth > 0, all concurrency slots are occupied.

panels.title: Upstream Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Percentile upstream (llama.cpp) latency from the upstream_wall_seconds histogram.

panels.title: Time to First Token (TTFT) p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Time to first token distribution. High TTFT indicates prompt processing bottleneck or queue wait.

panels.title: Queue Wait Time p50 / p95
panels.description: Time requests spend waiting in the concurrency queue. Elevated values mean concurrency slots are saturated.

panels.title: Token Throughput
panels.description: Token generation throughput. Completion tokens per second from the inference_tokens_total counter.

panels.title: Streaming Session Duration
panels.description: Distribution of streaming session wall-clock durations via streaming_duration_seconds histogram.

panels.title: Error Rate by Kind
panels.description: Error rate broken down by kind label. Includes upstream_timeout, upstream_unavailable, upstream_http.

panels.title: Request Rate by Mode
panels.description: Chat completion request rate split by mode (programmatic vs UI).

panels.title: Streaming In-Flight
panels.description: Currently active streaming upstream sessions. Spikes may indicate slow token generation.

panels.title: Validation & Rejection Rate
panels.description: Rate of requests rejected by validation or policy (malformed JSON, schema errors, prompt too long).

panels.title: Rate Limit & Quota Hits
panels.description: Rate of rate limit (429) and quota (429) rejections.

panels.title: Django Process Health
panels.description: Django worker RSS and CPU. Spikes may indicate memory leaks or excessive concurrent streaming.

panels.title: Queue Saturation
panels.description: Queue depth as a fraction of max queue size. 100% means queue is full and new requests get 503.

panels.title: Error Ratio
panels.description: Fraction of requests that result in errors. Should be below 5%.

panels.title: Gateway Process Health
panels.description: Gateway process RSS, CPU, and uptime. Memory growth under load may indicate leaks.

panels.title: Overload & Timeout Rate
panels.description: Rate of overload rejections (503) and upstream timeouts (504).

panels.title: TTFT Heatmap
panels.description: Time-to-first-token distribution over time. Brighter regions indicate higher request density at that latency range.

panels.title: Batch Queue Depth
panels.description: Requests currently waiting in the batch barrier. Non-zero means batching is active.

panels.title: Batch Efficiency
panels.description: Cumulative batching efficiency. 0 = all single-request batches, approaches 1 as batches grow.

panels.title: Avg Batch Size
panels.description: Average number of requests per batch (5m rolling). Higher is better for throughput.

panels.title: Batch Dispatch Rate
panels.description: Rate of batch dispatches per second. Single-request batches show batching overhead.

panels.title: Batch Size Over Time
panels.description: Batch size distribution over time from the batch_size histogram.

panels.title: Batch Wait Time p50 / p95
panels.description: Time requests spend waiting in the batch barrier before upstream dispatch.

panels.title: RAG Request Rate
panels.description: RAG-augmented chat completion rate

panels.title: RAG Hallucination Fallbacks
panels.description: Times the model said 'not found in documents' — low retrieval confidence

panels.title: Documents Ready
panels.description: Documents successfully indexed and ready for querying

panels.title: Ingestion & Chunks Rate
panels.description: Document upload rate

panels.title: Retrieval Latency p50 / p95
panels.description: Time to embed query + search ChromaDB + filter results

panels.title: Avg Chunks Retrieved per Query
panels.description: Average number of chunks returned per RAG query

panels.title: Ingestion Duration
panels.description: Time to fully process a document (extract, chunk, embed, store)

panels.title: TTFT Comparison (p50/p95)
panels.description: Time to first token separated by backend (p50 and p95)

panels.title: Upstream Latency Comparison (p50/p95)
panels.description: Total upstream wall time by backend (p50 and p95)

panels.title: Request Rate by Backend
panels.description: Requests per second by backend

panels.title: Token Throughput by Backend
panels.description: Completion tokens per second by backend

panels.title: Error Rate by Backend
panels.description: Error rate by backend (upstream errors, timeouts, etc.)

panels.title: Active Requests by Backend
panels.description: Currently active inference requests by backend — compare against INFERENCE_MAX_CONCURRENCY

panels.title: Streaming Sessions In-Flight by Backend
panels.description: Currently active SSE streaming sessions by backend
